raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Decode-side twin of #44070 / #44081.

A HiCache load-back attaches its device pages to the radix tree when **queued** (`commit_load_back`), before the H2D copy runs. With `--disaggregation-decode-enable-radix-cache --enable-hierarchical-cache`, the decode restore state machine (`decode_hicache_mixin.py`) marks requests READY through three shortcuts that never wait for that copy:

1. **Prealloc L1 hit**: B arrives while A loads the same prefix, matches A's pages as device prefix and is READY at once. Every reproduction hit this path.
2. **Rematch with nothing to load**: `loaded_len == 0` sets READY.
3. **State-only load** (hybrid models): `init_load_back` queues a Mamba/SWA state DMA but returns `loaded_len == 0`. The request is READY, and Phase C never runs, so the DMA is never submitted.

Decode batches don't set `hicache_consumer_index`, so the forward doesn't wait either. B reads pages still being written, which may hold another request's KV (#44070).

## Modifications

+47/-8 in two files. `decode.py`, both tree cores, `_OngoingLoadBack`, `loading_check` and the KV connectors are unchanged.

- `UnifiedRadixCache.latest_load_back_index()`: newest in-flight load-back, or -1.
- `decode_hicache_mixin.py`:
  - Phase A/B/C move unchanged into `_advance_hicache_local_restores`; shortcuts 1 and 2 no longer set READY.
  - `_try_hicache_queue_load_back` counts a DMA as queued when `load_queue` grows, so state-only loads go through Phase C.
  - New `_gate_reused_device_pages`, run after Phase C: a request reusing device pages without its own DMA binds once to the newest load-back and turns READY when it completes. Load-backs complete in order on one H2D stream. With none in flight, it is READY in the same tick, as before.

## Accuracy

2 × RTX 4090, 1P1D, `mooncake_tcp`, Qwen3-0.6B, 24,576-token shared prefix, decode HiCache (`write_through`, `direct` IO), `--disaggregation-enable-kv-checksum` on both sides. Each trial evicts prefix X to decode host memory, then sends two requests sharing X. Decode checksums the whole sequence, including the restored prefix. The existing hook `SGLANG_TEST_HICACHE_H2D_DELAY_CYCLES=50000000` stretches the H2D from ~0.12 s to ~0.76 s.

| Requests with KV checksum mismatch | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Concurrent pair | **20/40** (20/20 trials) | 0/20 |
| Concurrent pair, delayed H2D | **9/20** | 0/20 |
| Second request 100 ms late, delayed H2D | **10/20** (10/10 trials) | 0/20 |
| Second request 50 ms late | — | 0/20 |
| Control: sequential pair / single request | 0/20 / 0/10 | — |

On main the failing request finishes in 0.08–0.12 s, before the H2D completes; with this PR it waits for it.

New unit test `test_decode_hicache_restore_in_flight.py` (5 cases): 4 fail on main, including the stuck state-only DMA; all pass with this PR. All 194 files under `test/registered/unit/{mem_cache,disaggregation}/` give the same results as on main. The failures that exist on main (OOM from a shared GPU, no Rust workspace in the test copy) show the same errors on both.

## Cost

The gate is conservative: a request reusing an **unrelated** device prefix also waits for the newest load-back. Extra latency for an unrelated 8K-token prefix hit arriving 20 ms into a 24K-token load-back (median; alone it takes 0.088 s):

| Timing | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Host-staged KV transfer (mooncake TCP) | +0.140 s | +0.178 s |
| Delayed H2D (≈ GPUDirect RDMA timing) | +0.046 s | **+0.664 s** |

- **Host-staged**: B's KV queues behind A's H2D on the copy engine anyway, so the gate adds only ~0.04 s.
- **GPUDirect RDMA**: B's KV skips the copy engine, so the gate can hold an unrelated request for up to one full load-back. We couldn't run real RDMA. The delayed-H2D row approximates it, because the sleep kernel delays the DMA without occupying the copy engine.
- Requests with no device prefix, or arriving with no load-back in flight, are never held.

## Possible follow-up

The gate can be narrowed to requests whose prefix overlaps an in-flight load-back, by comparing tokens past the loader's pre-load device prefix. This needs no device sync and no tree-core change. An early prototype brought the unrelated-prefix delay back to main's level. I've kept it out to keep this fix small, and can send it once this lands or if you'd like it here.

## Not covered

Tested with TP=1/PP=1, the Rust tree core, the `direct` IO backend and mooncake TCP only. Not run: NIXL, real GPUDirect RDMA, PP > 1, hybrid models on GPU (the state-only path is covered by the unit test only).

nodes.body: Hi @ShangmingCai @hnyls2002, this is the decode-side counterpart of #44081 (cc @nvpohanh, since you've been helping with that one). Could you take a look when you have time, and add the CI label if it looks reasonable? I'm happy to adjust anything. Thanks a lot!

FYI, we hit the same race in sglang-torchtpu (TPU backend), found by code audit; we haven't reproduced it on TPU. Our fix is https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu/pull/1355, which is still in review. It extends an existing hold that covered only the sliding-window decode cache https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu/pull/1046 to every PD decode prefix cache.

Solid fix, and `test_decode_hicache_restore_in_flight.py` (5 cases) is exactly the right CPU regression guard — 4 fail on main, all pass here.

One observation on the gate's conservativeness: `_gate_reused_device_pages` holds any request reusing device pages while *any* load-back is in flight, even an unrelated prefix (your measurements show up to one full load-back of extra latency on the unrelated-hit path under GPUDirect RDMA). You already note the follow-up that narrows the gate to prefixes overlapping the in-flight load-back (compare tokens past the loader's pre-load device prefix; no device sync, no tree-core change), which would recover that unrelated-hit latency. Worth landing as a follow-up PR once this merges. LGTM.

+"""Decode HiCache restores must not turn READY on pages a load-back is still writing."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode_hicache_mixin import (
+    DecodeHiCacheTransferMixin,
+    DecodePrefixMatch,
+    HiCacheRestoreResult,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_prefix_cache import CacheRequestHandle
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_radix_cache import UnifiedRadixCache
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PREFIX_LEN = 8
+PENDING = HiCacheRestoreResult.PENDING
+READY = HiCacheRestoreResult.READY
+
+
+class _FakeTreeCache:
+    """UnifiedRadixCache's load-back bookkeeping for one host-resident prefix.
+
+    As in ``load_back``, a restore attaches its device pages to the tree when the
+    load is queued; its H2D copy finishes only when the test says so.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, on_device=False, state_only_load=False, free_slot=True):
+        self.device_pages = torch.arange(100, 100 + PREFIX_LEN)
+        self.on_device = on_device
+        self.state_only_load = state_only_load
+        self.free_slot = free_slot
+        self.ongoing_load_back = {}
+        self.cache_controller = SimpleNamespace(
+            load_queue=[], layer_done_counter=SimpleNamespace(producer_index=-1)
+        )
+        self.done = set()
+
+    def has_free_load_back_slot(self):
+        return self.free_slot
+
+    def init_load_back(self, params):
+        if self.state_only_load:
+            # KV is on device; only this request's Mamba state comes from host.
+            self.state_only_load = False
+            self.add_load()
+            return 0, "node"
+        if self.on_device:
+            return 0, "node"
+        self.on_device = True
+        self.add_load()
+        return PREFIX_LEN, "node"
+
+    def add_load(self):
+        self.ongoing_load_back[len(self.ongoing_load_back)] = "node"
+        self.cache_controller.load_queue.append("op")
+
+    def ready_to_load_host_cache(self):
+        if not self.cache_controller.load_queue:
+            return -1
+        self.cache_controller.load_queue.clear()
+        counter = self.cache_controller.layer_done_counter
+        counter.producer_index = (counter.producer_index + 1) % 3
+        return counter.producer_index
+
+    def latest_load_back_index(self):
+        return UnifiedRadixCache.latest_load_back_index(self)
+
+    def is_load_back_event_done(self, index):
+        return index < 0 or index in self.done
+
+    def finish_loads(self):
+        self.done.add(self.cache_controller.layer_done_counter.producer_index)
+        self.ongoing_load_back.clear()
+
+    def path_device_indices(self, node):
+        return self.device_pages
+
+    def lock(self, node):
+        return f"lock-{node}"
+
+
+def _host_hit(rid):
+    """A request whose prefix is host-only at prealloc."""
+    no_device_prefix = torch.tensor([], dtype=torch.int64)
+    return _decode_req(rid, DecodePrefixMatch(no_device_prefix, PREFIX_LEN, 0, "root"))
+
+
+def _device_hit(rid, tree):
+    """A request whose prealloc match already found the prefix on device."""
+    return _decode_req(rid, DecodePrefixMatch(tree.device_pages, 0, 0, "node"))
+
+
+def _decode_req(rid, prefix_match):
+    req = SimpleNamespace(
+        rid=rid,
+        cache_request_handle=CacheRequestHandle(rid, 0),
+        origin_input_ids=list(range(PREFIX_LEN + 4)),
+        last_node="root",
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        req=req,
+        prefix_match=prefix_match,
+        hicache_restore_status=PENDING,
+        hicache_restore_lock=None,
+        hicache_restored_kv_indices=None,
+        hicache_load_consumer_index=-1,
+    )
+
+
+class TestDecodeHiCacheRestoreInFlight(CustomTestCase):
+    def _tick(self, tree, decode_reqs, kv_on_device=None):
+        harness = SimpleNamespace(tree_cache=tree)
+        for name in (
+            "_try_hicache_queue_load_back",
+            "_advance_hicache_local_restores",
+            "_gate_reused_device_pages",
+        ):
+            method = getattr(DecodeHiCacheTransferMixin, name, None)
+            if method is not None:
+                setattr(harness, name, method.__get__(harness))
+
+        def rematch(req, tree_cache, *args, **kwargs):
+            on_device = tree_cache.on_device if kv_on_device is None else kv_on_device
+            return SimpleNamespace(
+                device_prefix_len=PREFIX_LEN if on_device else 0,
+                best_match_node="node",
+                host_hit_length=0 if on_device else PREFIX_LEN,
+            )
+
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode_hicache_mixin.match_kv_cache",
+            side_effect=rematch,
+        ):
+            DecodeHiCacheTransferMixin._process_hicache_local_restores(
+                harness, decode_reqs
+            )
+
+    def test_rematch_onto_pages_of_an_in_flight_load_waits_for_it(self):
+        tree = _FakeTreeCache()
+        loader, follower = _host_hit("loader"), _host_hit("follower")
+
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, follower])
+        # The loader queued the DMA; the follower rematched onto its pages.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            follower.hicache_restored_kv_indices.tolist(), tree.device_pages.tolist()
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(loader.hicache_restore_status, PENDING)
+        self.assertEqual(follower.hicache_restore_status, PENDING)
+
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, follower])
+        self.assertEqual(follower.hicache_restore_status, PENDING)
+
+        tree.finish_loads()
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, follower])
+        self.assertEqual(loader.hicache_restore_status, READY)
+        self.assertEqual(follower.hicache_restore_status, READY)
+
+    def test_prealloc_device_hit_on_an_in_flight_load_waits_for_it(self):
+        tree = _FakeTreeCache()
+        loader = _host_hit("loader")
+        self._tick(tree, [loader])
+
+        # Prealloc matched the loader's pages as L1 while their H2D is pending.
+        late = _device_hit("late", tree)
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, late])
+        self.assertEqual(late.hicache_restore_status, PENDING)
+
+        tree.finish_loads()
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, late])
+        self.assertEqual(late.hicache_restore_status, READY)
+
+    def test_state_only_load_back_holds_loader_and_reuser(self):
+        # KV is on device; only the loader's Mamba state is restored from host.
+        tree = _FakeTreeCache(on_device=True, state_only_load=True)
+        loader, reuser = _host_hit("loader"), _device_hit("reuser", tree)
+
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, reuser], kv_on_device=True)
+        # The state DMA was submitted, not left in the queue.
+        self.assertEqual(tree.cache_controller.load_queue, [])
+        self.assertEqual(loader.hicache_restore_status, PENDING)
+        self.assertEqual(reuser.hicache_restore_status, PENDING)
+
+        tree.finish_loads()
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, reuser], kv_on_device=True)
+        self.assertEqual(loader.hicache_restore_status, READY)
+        self.assertEqual(reuser.hicache_restore_status, READY)
+
+    def test_device_hit_waits_even_when_no_load_slot_is_free(self):
+        tree = _FakeTreeCache()
+        loader = _host_hit("loader")
+        self._tick(tree, [loader])
+
+        tree.free_slot = False
+        late = _device_hit("late", tree)
+        self._tick(tree, [loader, late])
+        self.assertEqual(late.hicache_restore_status, PENDING)
+
+    def test_device_hits_without_in_flight_load_are_ready_at_once(self):
+        tree = _FakeTreeCache(on_device=True)
+        rematched, prealloc_hit = _host_hit("rematched"), _device_hit("hit", tree)
+
+        self._tick(tree, [rematched, prealloc_hit])
+
+        self.assertEqual(rematched.hicache_restore_status, READY)
+        self.assertEqual(prealloc_hit.hicache_restore_status, READY)
+        self.assertEqual(rematched.hicache_restore_lock, "lock-node")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

issue_comments.body: Hi @ShangmingCai @hnyls2002, this is the decode-side counterpart of #44081 (cc @nvpohanh, since you've been helping with that one). Could you take a look when you have time, and add the CI label if it looks reasonable? I'm happy to adjust anything. Thanks a lot!

FYI, we hit the same race in sglang-torchtpu (TPU backend), found by code audit; we haven't reproduced it on TPU. Our fix is https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu/pull/1355, which is still in review. It extends an existing hold that covered only the sliding-window decode cache https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu/pull/1046 to every PD decode prefix cache.

Solid fix, and `test_decode_hicache_restore_in_flight.py` (5 cases) is exactly the right CPU regression guard — 4 fail on main, all pass here.

One observation on the gate's conservativeness: `_gate_reused_device_pages` holds any request reusing device pages while *any* load-back is in flight, even an unrelated prefix (your measurements show up to one full load-back of extra latency on the unrelated-hit path under GPUDirect RDMA). You already note the follow-up that narrows the gate to prefixes overlapping the in-flight load-back (compare tokens past the loader's pre-load device prefix; no device sync, no tree-core change), which would recover that unrelated-hit latency. Worth landing as a follow-up PR once this merges. LGTM.
